narrative: The tech world sees significant advancements in AI, robotics, and infrastructure, with new models and hardware boosting capabilities. Space exploration continues with NASA missions, while cybersecurity and privacy remain key concerns amidst evolving digital landscapes. Developers are exploring new tools and frameworks for enhanced productivity and security.

highlights.title: Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for layoffs — here are 20 others
highlights.whyItMatters: AI's growing integration is impacting the job market, leading to significant layoffs across numerous tech companies as roles evolve.

highlights.title: GM Backs Sodium Ion Batteries for U.S. Grid Storage
highlights.whyItMatters: The adoption of sodium-ion batteries by major manufacturers like GM signals a shift towards more sustainable and scalable energy storage solutions.

highlights.title: Elon Musk’s Boring Company reportedly raising funding at a $20 billion valuation
highlights.whyItMatters: Significant investment in Elon Musk's Boring Company highlights continued interest and confidence in advanced infrastructure and tunneling technologies.

highlights.title: The new rules of context engineering for Claude 5 generation models
highlights.whyItMatters: Advancements in large language models, like Claude 5, are leading to new best practices for context engineering, crucial for AI development.

highlights.title: NASA’s ESCAPADE Snaps Family Portrait of Earth, Moon
highlights.whyItMatters: NASA's ESCAPADE mission provides stunning new perspectives on Earth and the Moon, advancing our understanding of celestial dynamics.

highlights.title: Supercooled kidneys have been transplanted into pigs in a “landmark achievement”
highlights.whyItMatters: A breakthrough in organ preservation could revolutionize transplant medicine by extending the viability of donor organs significantly.

highlights.title: Cloudflare Internal DNS is now generally available
highlights.whyItMatters: Cloudflare's Internal DNS enhances private network security and performance by integrating authoritative and recursive DNS on a global network.

highlights.title: NVIDIA Introduces New Jetson Thor Computers to Advance Mainstream Robotics and Edge AI
highlights.whyItMatters: NVIDIA's new Jetson Thor modules are designed to power next-generation robotics and edge AI applications with compact, energy-efficient supercomputing.
